request.style: English, traditional folk, clear steady female vocal, acoustic guitar, fiddle, mountain dulcimer, upright bass, soft frame drum, earnest and plain, 96 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
On the morning of the third day thunder rolled across the plain
Lightning on the mountain and a cloud as dark as rain
The horn blew loud and louder and the camp began to shake
Sinai wrapped in smoke and fire for the people's sake

[Chorus]
I am the LORD your God
Who brought you out of the land of Egypt
Out of the house of slavery
You shall have no other gods before me

[Verse]
You shall not make for yourself an idol
You shall not misuse the name of the LORD your God
Remember the Sabbath day by keeping it holy
Six days you shall labor and do all your work

[Chorus]
I am the LORD your God
Who brought you out of the land of Egypt
Out of the house of slavery
You shall have no other gods before me

[Verse]
Honor your father and your mother
You shall not murder
You shall not commit adultery
You shall not steal
You shall not give false testimony against your neighbor
You shall not covet your neighbor's house

[Bridge]
Not a burden laid on slaves but a road for people free
Ten words spoken from the fire for all who would believe
Showing steadfast love to a thousand generations
Of those who love me and keep my commandments

[Chorus]
I am the LORD your God
Who brought you out of the land of Egypt
Out of the house of slavery
You shall have no other gods before me
